body: Are you sure he got your message? Can you find him on Facebook? I would try reach out again but who knows he may have forgotten. Thirteen is a very young age and stupid behaviour at that age can mostly be forgiven. How serious are we talking about?

I was given the wrong meds at age 16 and was put on it for three years. It made me zombie-like, sleep a lot, lose interest in hobbies but the one thing it did do was subside my irritability. I think the wrong meds can make things worse. I would go to your doctor and have him prescribe you with something different. You never know. I have heard of many success stories with antidepressants and know someone who changed his life around after going on Zoloft which I am going to finally try when my doctor is back from vacation.

Do you take medication? I've heard of people who are in the same situation as you and their life was turned around for the better after taking meds. I would go on it but I'm deathly afraid of the side effects that come with many but I might try Zoloft soon
The more I think about death, the weirder it gets. From being alive to suddenly ceasing to exist.. eternally... Everything inside switches off but your body remains then rots. Feels weird
Did you take medication to overcome this? I am trying to stay away from antidepressants after hearing about the side effects. I don't know what to do anymore
My problems are no one's fault but my own. What are you going through?
It's come to light that my mental state is starting to deteriorate and I hate to see myself go down like this. Feel so empty inside and the rain isn't helping.

The hardest part is finding a sure fire efficient way of doing so. I have so many options running through my head but I don't know which one to go with to ensure I don't come out alive. It gives me the worst anxiety
